_comment: Portable SSOT config for the agent-chat collaboration environment. Paths are relative to the repo root. Server reads host/port from here (env vars override). Migration export/import reads runtimeData.globs. This file IS committed to git; runtime data is not.

runtimeData._comment: Machine-local runtime state. Git-ignored; carried between PCs only via scripts/export-runtime.cjs + import-runtime.cjs. SSOT for both .gitignore and the migration scripts.

runtime._comment: Prerequisites a target PC must provide. Node is the portable baseline (cross-OS). pwsh/.ps1 are optional Windows convenience only.
